why: Source: derive four years' total sales from profit divided by margin, divide each segment profit by sales, compare (3 steps); question: the same three steps on a stacked bar with bar notes, with no step added or dropped.

Source: sum twelve revenue bars, take the top-two share, two per-head ratio comparisons and one no-calculation profitability check (about 5 steps); question: the same total, top-two share, two per-head comparisons and a no-cost profitability check (about 5 steps).

Source: convert units to kg, cost at the flat rate, cost under the volume threshold tier, difference, ignore the constant other cost (5 steps); question: the same conversion, flat cost, tiered threshold cost, difference and constant-cost trap (5 steps).

Source: three per-broker share ratios, two combined-class ratios, check four statements (about 6 steps); question: three per-merchant ratios, two combined-class ratios, check four statements (about 6 steps).
Source: read five weekday values off gridlines, sum, divide by 5 not 7 (3 steps plus the divide-by-7 trap); question: the same gridline reading, sum, and divide by 5 with the same 7-day trap.
Source: sum twelve revenue bars, sum twelve headcount bars, divide and convert millions to dollars (4 steps); question: the same two sums, division and unit conversion (4 steps).
Source: sum profits, apply 10% growth, sum products, divide and scale millions to pounds (4 steps); question: the same four steps on a three-column table.
Source: five income-over-cost ratios then rank them (6 steps); question: five fare-over-fuel ratios then rank them (6 steps).

Source: read segments of two unlabelled 100% bars, combine totals, weighted shares for the statements needing calculation (two) plus bound checks (about 5 steps); question: the same gridline reading and combined total with three weighted shares and one bound check (about 6 steps), a difference of one.

Source: sum a three-bar group and take a share, sum a four-bar group and take its share of total, two threshold checks against the total (about 6 steps); question: the same group sums, shares and two threshold checks on the waterfall (about 6 steps).
